quiz.question: Where should a team keep files they all work on together?
options: A SharePoint site or Teams channel
quiz.answer_text: A SharePoint site or Teams channel
quiz.why: Team files belong in SharePoint (a Teams channel's Files tab is SharePoint), so they don't vanish when one person leaves.
